# Security Policy / 安全策略

This policy explains how to report security issues without exposing users or maintainers to additional risk.

## Supported Versions / 支持版本

Scenix is currently developed from `master` without a formal long-term support release. Security fixes target the latest code on `master`.

Scenix 当前以 `master` 分支持续开发，尚无长期支持版本。安全修复以 `master` 最新代码为目标。

## Reporting a Vulnerability / 报告漏洞

Please do not open a public Issue for a vulnerability or include credentials, private data, or exploit details in public discussions.

请勿使用公开 Issue 披露漏洞，也不要在公开讨论中提交凭据、隐私数据或利用细节。

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/paynewinnt/scenix/security/advisories/new) whenever possible. Include:

- affected version or commit;
- impact and attack scenario;
- reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept;
- suggested mitigation, if available.

请优先使用 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/paynewinnt/scenix/security/advisories/new)，并提供受影响版本、影响范围、复现步骤和可行的缓解建议。

If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository owner at `paynewinn@gmail.com` before sharing technical details. Security reports are handled on a best-effort basis; please allow maintainers time to confirm and coordinate a fix before public disclosure.

如果 GitHub 私密报告入口不可用，请先通过 `paynewinn@gmail.com` 联系仓库所有者，不要直接公开技术细节。项目会尽力处理安全报告，并在公开披露前协调确认与修复。
